The vendor directly providing the **Codecademy** software product and platform at **codecademy.com** is **Codecademy LLC** (an operating subsidiary of Skillsoft).

### Supporting Evidence:
* **Terms of Service:** *"Welcome to Codecademy, the website and mobile service of Codecademy LLC (“Codecademy,” “we,” or “us”). This page explains the terms by which you may use our online and/or mobile services, website, and software provided on or in connection with the service (collectively the “Service”)."*
* **Privacy Policy:** *"Codecademy LLC (“Codecademy,” “we,” “our,” or “us”) is committed to protecting your privacy... This Privacy Policy applies to the online services offered by Codecademy such as our website at www.codecademy.com, our mobile app Codecademy Go, and any other online service location..."*
* **Teams Master Subscription Agreement:** *"This Teams Master Subscription Agreement... governs use of the Codecademy Platform (as defined below) offered by Codecademy LLC (“Codecademy”), a New York limited liability company..."*
